title: Help and questions
lead: Straight answers about planning, booking and what happens when something runs late.

buffers.a: The time between one ride arriving and the next one leaving. Every connection has a hard minimum for its mode and place, and a comfortable buffer we aim for. Trips under the minimum are never offered.

risk.q: What does the risk figure mean?
risk.a: It is our estimate of the chance that you miss a connection, based on the buffer and how late that service has run before. We show it as low, medium or high, always with the number.

estimated.q: Why are some prices marked as estimated?
estimated.a: Taxis often have no published fare. We estimate from distance and mark the price as estimated until the operator confirms it.

late.q: What happens if a ferry or flight runs late?
late.a: You get a notification and a suggested new plan that keeps every remaining connection safe. You choose whether to switch.

time.q: Which time zone do you use?
time.a: Maldives time (UTC+5) everywhere. There is no daylight saving.
